title: SE implementation scratchpad - Fairview Bank
content:
Daily scratchpad - Fairview Bank (private deployment)
Owner: Maya Chen
TL;DR: prepping for infra kickoff + canary plan. Key open items: KMS/HSM integration, network peering, capacity commit window, model variant for sensitive PII handling.

TODAY (2026-03-03)
- 09:30 sync w/ Priya (security) - confirm KMS controls + SCIM mapping.
- 11:00 call with Fairview infra (Amy) - confirm VPC peering CIDR, NAT + egress constraints.
- Prep canary run plan + dataset for quality evals (short prompt set from Amy).
- Draft Dedicated capacity estimate for first 3 months (baseline: 2x A100 equiv, burst to 4x).

ACTION ITEMS
- [ ] Get final CIDR ranges from Fairview (Amy) -> need by 2026-03-05. Note: prefer /20 but customer might be /22.
- [ ] Confirm whether Fairview requires HSM-backed key wraps (yes/no) -> Priya to confirm.
- [ ] Add firewall rules to infra doc: allow 443 to control-plane, allow SSH from SE jumpbox only, add monitoring endpoints.
- [ ] Create canary policy: 5% traffic -> 1 model variant (quantized q4f), 95% fallback to hosted LLM for non-PII.
- [ ] Generate eval prompt set (50 prompts) focused on KYC-related redaction cases.

CONFIG NOTES / CLI SNIPPETS
- Deploy config (draft):
  - model: redwood-llama2-13b-q4f
  - batch: target 32ms p50, dynamic batching window 20ms
  - kv-cache TTL: 10m (customer session length ~8m)
  - quantization: q4f recommended for cost/latency tradeoff

- Network / peering checklist:
  - Control plane endpoints: 34.120.12.45, 34.120.12.46 (HTTPS 443)
  - Private deployment agents must reach KMS: kms.fairview.example.com:443 (allow egress)
  - VPN/peering: prefer Cloud Interconnect; fallback to IPsec if interconnect not available

- Example command to validate deployment (internal):
  ./deploy-check.sh --env fairview --model redwood-llama2-13b-q4f --verify-kms

RISKS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- HSM availability timeline could delay go-live by 2-3 weeks if customer insists on on-prem HSM. Mitigation: propose cloud KMS + attestation until HSM is delivered.
- Firewall/egress policy: customer has strict egress filtering (only approved domains). Need list of Redwood control-plane domains. Action: Liam to provide domain/IP whitelist.
- Data residency: Fairview insists logs not leave EU region for PII flows. Confirm if Private control plane can be deployed in eu-west-1 (ops ask).

MEETING NOTES (quick) - 2026-03-02
- Amy: prefers dedicated VPC with log forwarding to their SIEM. Wants SAML SSO + SCIM.
- Security: need strong audit trail, token rotation every 30d, and KMS access logs.

NEXT STEPS
- Today: finalize canary doc + share with customer before EOD.
- Tomorrow: infra kickoff (internal) w/ Ops + Release Eng to validate autoscaling policies.
- This week: draft SLAs & support runbook for Fairview (on-call rotation, escalation matrix).

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep demo lightweight: show fast cold-start + prefix caching benefits.
- Prepare cost delta slide: q4f vs fp16 vs hosted fallback (per-token cost estimates).
- Follow up PR: git://repo/redwood-deploy-configs/pull/87 - add fairview env vars.

random thoughts / scratch:
- maybe recommend HDR logging level for first 2 weeks, then drop to info.
- think about adding 'PII redaction' preprocessor to reduce model risk - ask Applied ML for a quick script.

End of scratchpad.
